turns.text: Hey Lloyd, did you see the latest update on the GigaWorld-Policy model? It looks like GigaWorld-Policy achieves a 7% higher success rate than Motus.
That is a significant improvement. I have noted that performance gap.
Yeah, the benchmark charts were pretty clear on that. Anyway, do you remember if I ordered the new mechanical keyboard switches last week?
I do not have access to your personal purchase history, but I can help you track it if you provide the order number.
Ah, right. I'll check my email. By the way, it's raining here again. I hate this weather.
I'm sorry to hear that. You might need an umbrella if you plan to go out later.
Probably. I was thinking about making pasta for dinner instead of going out. Any quick recipe ideas?
Aglio e Olio is quick and simple. Just garlic, olive oil, chili flakes, and pasta.
